title: Operational Governance Technical Reference
readerIntent: Audit lifecycle, observability, runtime governance, and operational evidence.
owner: Runtime lifecycle, diagnostics, audit, health, and nDynamo contracts
summary: Every operational capability defines readiness, bounded lifecycle, safe signals, authority, failure, recovery, retention, and tests.

sections.heading: Checklist
items: Owned resource, contributor name/order/deadline, required/optional dependency, readiness, drain, shutdown, and cleanup.
Trace/correlation, tenant, module, operation, safe outcomes, metrics cardinality, audit, masking, retention, and alerts.
Preview, approval, actor separation, digest/revision, activation, conflict, cleanup, rollback, backup, and restore.
Positive, negative, timeout, restart, hard-failure, contract, integration, distributed topology, security, load, incident-recovery, and regression tests.
